FAQ

Common questions

Don't see your question? Call or text and we'll get right back to you.

Do I need to be home?

No. As long as we can reach the area and an outdoor water spigot, we can do the job while you're out. We'll text you when it's done.

How long does a driveway take?

Most standard driveways take a couple of hours, depending on size and how dirty the concrete is. We'll give you an estimate with your quote.

Will pressure washing damage my surfaces?

We match the method to the surface. Flat concrete gets a surface cleaner for an even result, and siding and fences get lower pressure so nothing gets etched or gouged.

How do I get a price?

Call or text 631-461-3335 with what you need cleaned and your general location. Sending a photo is the fastest way to get an accurate price.

What areas do you serve?

Fort Lauderdale and nearby neighborhoods in Broward County. If you're not sure we cover you, just ask.
